verdict.rationale: Jules runs tasks autonomously in a cloud VM. The API wording "if your session requires explicit plan approval" implies plan approval is optional per session, and the optional `automationMode` field can make Jules create PRs automatically. Together these point to a hands-off mode, but none of it is documented as a single auto-approve-all setting, and the default flow still has a plan-approval step. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to disable plan approval (field or setting name), an equivalent toggle in the web UI, a documented auto-approve-everything mode, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
